'''David Fairbanks''' (also published as '''David Farbank''')<ref name="dt-18651">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18651 Agents of Phil  Post Coruscant], DeckTech (David_F "SabacOwnsJ00" airbanks, 28 August 2001).
